summary.name: Notchly
summary.one_liner: Notchly is a macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into an interactive "Dynamic Island" for music controls, AI coding agent alerts, and related system features.
use_cases: control music playback from the notch
see what's playing without opening apps
get alerts when AI coding agents finish work
monitor long-running Codex or Claude Code tasks
use the MacBook notch as a quick-access panel
summary.what_it_does: Notchly places an interactive Dynamic Island-style panel in the MacBook notch area. It provides media controls to see what is playing, play or jump between tracks, and keep music controls close at hand. It also shows glanceable alerts from Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code so that long-running AI agent work is visible. The page also mentions gesture and system control features in its description. The page says it is installed by over 1.1k Mac users.
notable: Dynamic Island-style interface in the MacBook notch
Glanceable AI coding agent alerts for Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code
Listed as open source and native on awesome-mac
caveats: Page does not give details on paid tiers or pricing beyond 'free to get started'
Support is handled through GitHub issues only, per the page
